I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

- **Content:** It has the "Audit log" heading, a "Date range" select set to "Last 7 days", and the eight events with time, person and action, all as you gave them. The whole screen sits inside `#component` at 1280px wide, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.
- **Design rules:** I followed `DESIGN.md`. That means its colors, type sizes, radii and spacing, a 56px light all-caps Unbounded heading, and the blue accent used only on the "Date range" label. The 64px page margins are in. The 12-column grid is not: the event rows use fixed column widths instead.
- **Hover:** Rows and the select tint on hover without moving. Motion is turned off when reduced motion is set.
- **Fonts:** There are no font files in the folder, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to system sans-serif unless they're installed on the machine.
- **Select options:** The select has only the one "Last 7 days" option, since no others were specified.
